title: Grateful Dead Live at Rainbow Theater on 1981-03-20
source: Source Info: 1st Set: Frank Streeter's Master FOB Audience  assette; Sennheiser 421 > Sony TC-D5M (TDK MA90); 2nd Set: Master FOB Audience Cassette; AKG 224> Sony TC-D5M > 1 cassette gen (Maxell UDXLII); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz)> KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition 3.0> TLH flac2496; Transfer by Charlie Miller; Mastered by Scott Clugston

ai_review.summary: Nice audience recording that captures a kicking set with standout Scarlet Fire, Althea and Wharf Rat.
ai_review.review: The audience tape delivers solid sound quality for the price, letting listeners enjoy a high‑energy performance highlighted by Scarlet Fire, Althea, Wharf Rat, Candyman and He's Gone. The show is praised as “kicking butt,” with no major flaws noted in either playing or recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review emphasizes strong musical performance and decent audience sound; rating reflects good show quality with acceptable recording fidelity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience capture is clear enough for enjoyment, offering a pleasant balance of crowd ambience and instrument clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall flow described as strong and energetic, with the set “kicking butt” throughout.
